title: Narrative Response
description: Structured narrative fields returned by the bounded n8n/LLM step. Contains only allowed text fields referencing existing finding IDs. No HTML, CSS, scores, new URLs, or new findings. Schema version 1.0.0.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the narrative was generated.

modelId.description: Identifier of the LLM model that produced this response.

promptVersion.description: Version of the prompt template used.

executiveSummary.description: Concise executive interpretation from approved facts. Plain text only — no HTML, no CSS, no Markdown.

priorityFixNarrative.description: Narrative describing the highest-priority fixes in client-facing language. Plain text only.

conversionPathNarrative.description: Narrative describing conversion path findings. Plain text only.

readinessMapNarrative.description: Narrative describing the conversion readiness map. Plain text only.

contentOpportunityNarrative.description: Narrative describing content opportunities. Plain text only.

competitorNarrative.description: Narrative describing competitor benchmark insights. Plain text only.

trustNarrative.description: Narrative describing trust and E-E-A-T findings. Plain text only.

technicalNarrative.description: Narrative describing technical SEO findings. Plain text only.

performanceNarrative.description: Narrative describing performance findings. Plain text only.

internalLinkNarrative.description: Narrative describing internal-link opportunities. Plain text only.

limitationsNarrative.description: Narrative describing limitations and deferred analysis. Plain text only.

referencedFindingIds.description: Finding IDs referenced in the narrative. Every ID must exist in the canonical report-content package.

fieldWordCounts.description: Recorded word counts per narrative field for limit enforcement.
